environment.description: Terraform provider binary running as root inside a Docker container with default seccomp profile (docker-default). Container has /etc and /var/run mounted as read-write volumes. Provider is invoked via terraform apply with user-supplied .tf files that specify source_path pointing to attacker-controlled directories. TF_FILE_MANAGER_POST_HOOK is set to 'true' in the container environment. No additional filesystem isolation or mandatory access control.
